stories.title: AI learning tool helps blind students excel in Malawi
stories.synopsis: A 25-year-old Malawian innovator has built an artificial intelligence tool for blind and visually impaired students. It is being used to help them improve their academic performance. It's a great example of a young creator opening up learning for classmates who have too often been left out.

stories.title: Developing a new accessibility AI app for virtual meetings
stories.synopsis: RNID, backed by Google.org, has created an Accessibility Assistant app that runs inside a popular video conferencing platform. It uses AI to analyse a meeting's audio, video, transcription and chat, then gives gentle prompts when communication barriers arise. This encourages deaf-aware meeting habits, and RNID is now inviting organisations to join trials of the tool.

stories.title: AI Learns to Design Enzymes, Cancer Cells Lose an Ally, and Webb Finds a Planet That Reflects the Heat
stories.synopsis: This science roundup highlights Vanderbilt chemists' MutexaGPT, a multi-agent AI system that helps turn a chemist's intuition into enzyme designs. The article notes it connects to the wider effort to use AI in drug discovery, where computer-made suggestions still have to survive laboratory and clinical testing. It's a hopeful look at AI working alongside human scientists.
